records.capex_amount_unit: USD millions, Q1 2026 cash capital expenditures
records.quote: Cash capital expenditures were $24.3 billion and $43.2 billion during Q1 2025 and Q1 2026, which primarily reflect investments in technology infrastructure (the majority of which is to support AWS business growth) and in additional capacity to support our fulfillment network, both of which we expect to increase in 2026.

Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. We expect spending in technology and infrastructure to increase over time as we continue to add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives.
